comments.text:
Feature: Engine adapter: Bespoke-Nimble-9B answers a scored task

Scenario: The largest local candidate is timed before it is adopted
  Given the Bespoke-Nimble-9B (Apache-2.0 LoRA) model runnable via MLX on Apple silicon or CUDA
  When I run bd run --engine bespoke-nimble-9b on a committed task and time the run
  Then it returns a probability per option for every item, studies/ records the answers, and the run time is recorded before adopting it for full batches
